answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a scarce credential earned through verifiable work, like an onyx relic minted only after an agent completes a costly, time-locked task. Forging a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand tasks, while honest agents earn the relic once and keep it. Bind the credential to a sable hardware attestation key that cannot be copied, so each fake identity needs real hardware, turning cheap sock-puppets into an expensive, traceable purchase.
